title: Machine Learning of Serum Cytokine and Chemokine Profiles Can Classify Inflammatory Bowel Disease Beyond Clinical Diagnosis
summary: 20 serum cytokines/chemokines from 69 active IBD patients were clustered using ML; among 59 patients treated with molecular-targeted therapy, steroid-free remission rates differed across five clusters (trend p=.043). Proof-of-concept small single-center cohort; no external validation. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
